words.sentence1: She showed remarkable fortitude during her difficult recovery. (She showed remarkable fortitude during her difficult recovery.)

words.meaning: Boldness or daring, willingness to take bold risks
words.sentence1: Il a fallu beaucoup d'audace pour mener à bien ce projet. (It took a lot of boldness to successfully carry out this project.)
words.sentence2: Son audace naturelle le pousse toujours vers de nouveaux défis. (His natural daring always pushes him toward new challenges.)

words.sentence1: Kare wa kowai mono shirazu no yūki o motte iru. (He has the courage of someone who knows no fear.)

words.meaning: Daring, boldness, or the courage to venture

words.meaning: To inspire, encourage, or rouse to action
